generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with edit-target.png first and L2-seed-region-r2-source.png second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The aggregate directional-key measure passes, but inspection shows brighter rock tops and darker vertical faces on the knoll, perimeter benches, tors, and boulders. The literal flat-value lighting rule is not met.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median dark-green crown-component width across 28 isolated candidate components, scaled by 2560/1254. The threshold measures conservative dark crown cores rather than pale branch tips, but the diagnostic overlay and direct inspection both show multiple full conifers below the required 41 source-pixel floor.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad purple field and open meadow/moor ground count as buildable; exposed knoll, bench, tor, and boulder faces count as steep; dense conifers, blossom-tree footprints, scree, broken rock, and the knoll top make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Connected source-raster classification of painted teal pixels within the inspected hydrology region, followed by bounded relaxed-colour growth, local raster closing, enclosed-hole filling, and inclusion of the final two contiguous cyan-blue wet pixels found by the repository hue-window classifier. The shoreline follows painted pixels, not a polyline.
water_mask.component_note: Rock occlusion and a diagonal two-pixel wet fringe split the single logical beck system into multiple raster components; no geometry was drawn across dry rock to force connectivity.

source_scale_gate_proxy.classifier: repository isWaterPaint cyan-to-blue hue window 150..225; violet and magenta ground excluded
source_scale_gate_proxy.note: node.exe is not exposed in this managed shell. This is a source-scale reproduction of the current repository classifier and scale-equivalent gate radii.

open_risks: Hard lighting failure: the numeric whole-image key-light metric passes, but the knoll and other rock forms visibly retain brighter upper surfaces over darker sides, contrary to the literal flat-value rule.
Hard scale failure: conservative conifer crown cores measure a 69.410 px / 3.332 m median at final scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; multiple full trees are visibly underscale.
Hard corridor failure: blossom trees and small outcrops occupy parts of the intended open ground south of the knoll, even though no path or route line was painted.
Hard geology risk: the knoll includes repeated upright block faces and bright caps, reading closer to a ring of columnar blocks than a rounded flat-value weathered basalt hill.
The local 6 px and 48 px painted-water fringe reproductions pass, but the official Node authoring gate was unavailable in this managed shell.

The previous path and purple-at-seam rejection conditions appear corrected by inspection. Seam continuity, exact crown bounds, geology naturalism, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report makes no visual acceptance claim.
